requested_outcome: Stop recurring public navigation crashes, return a verified result for every eligible unit when dates are checked for a whole vacation property, add both regressions to QQQAAA, publish once and verify production.
natural_destination: Public VII navigation, dated vacation business pages and QQQAAA.
authorization_boundary: Code, read-only supplier checks, tests, QQQAAA integration and one production publication are authorized. No supplier mutation, booking, lead, message or payment is authorized.

lesson_bundle.reason: The defects are interactive navigation and dated unit states.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Exercise loading, success, failure, retry, reload, desktop and mobile states.

lesson_bundle.reason: Each unit availability and price is a visible data contract.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Only supplier-verified unit results may be displayed and each result keeps its room ID.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user requires a production fix and durable QQQAAA coverage.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The exact public release and affected family must pass before completion.
Freeze one candidate, preserve the previous deployment as rollback and verify production.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The generic error page still appears after several navigations.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Remove expensive QA and catalog jobs from customer HTML requests and retain them only on the scheduler; add one bounded stale-asset recovery.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Repeated public navigation does not launch background maintenance and representative routes remain usable.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the supplier-selected cheapest unit has a price while other suites remain unknown.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Query and validate every eligible supplier room independently with bounded concurrency.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every unit card receives its own available, unavailable or unverified result and exact room link.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A visual patch hides the symptom but the worker can still exceed limits.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Test the worker source contract and scheduled path independently from the public request path.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Public fetch contains no maintenance trigger while scheduled keeps QA and catalog refresh.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The fix exists locally but not publicly or QQQAAA omits it.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Add a dedicated regression suite to QQQAAA and verify the exact deployed build with rollback identity.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: QQQAAA contains both checks and the exact public version passes them.

affected_family: global error boundary and stale asset recovery

midpoint_gate.trigger: After worker maintenance isolation and per-unit supplier adapter tests pass, before broad QA and release.
checks: Customer HTML requests no longer start QA or catalog jobs
Scheduled execution still owns both jobs
Per-unit results preserve exact room IDs and partial failures

attack_questions: Can one page view still start a sitewide QA run?
Can one failed room hide every other room?
Can a stale chunk cause an endless reload?
Can an unavailable room inherit another room's price?
Can QQQAAA pass without both regressions?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Repeated public navigation and a dated multi-unit business page on the exact release.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused tests, build, full tests, QQQAAA and public desktop/mobile checks.

effectiveness.baseline: Production v661 shows the generic route error during browsing and only one supplier-selected unit receives a full quote.
effectiveness.target: No recurring navigation error in the tested route matrix and one truthful result for every eligible unit.
